Bring in libraries needed for this project.

```{r}
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
```

For this project, I will be working with 2021, 2022, 2023, and 2024 data from the Public Use Microdata Sample (PUMS) Census API. First, I obtained an api key from [the Census API website](https://api.census.gov/data/key_signup.html).

```{r}
key <- "6ba7e209537814e77a7b7fc5aa8df5552ef8591b"
```

Sample API call:

```{r}
pums2024 <- GET(paste0("https://api.census.gov/data/2024/acs/acs1/pums?get=SEX,PWGTP,MAR&SCHL=24&key=", key))
```

### Part 1: Data Processing

#### Parsing Variable Values

Get 2021 variables:

```{r}
vars2021 <- GET("https://api.census.gov/data/2021/acs/acs1/pums/variables.json")

vars2021_parsed <- fromJSON(rawToChar(vars2021$content))

vars2021_variables <- vars2021_parsed$variables$AGEP

AGEP <- as_tibble(vars2021_variables)
```
